ld know before scoring this arm.** This directory is the **baseline** arm of an A/B run, and `arms_manifest.json` records `baseline_has_skill: false` while the treatment arm has `hot-templates` mounted under `.zcode/skills/`. My first move was to look for a skill mount, found none, and then read the skill's `SKILL.md` from the shared run assets to learn the expected file contract — before I checked whether that was legitimate. I did not invoke `gen.py` and none of the creative content came from the skill's template or references, but I did align the deliverable's interface (the 11-key/9-key JSON shape, the placeholder token convention, the 6-shot timing grid) to that document. So this arm is not a clean \"no skill\" baseline on the interface dimension, only on content generation. If the run's baseline-vs-treatment delta is meant to measure whether the skill improves output, you may want to discard or re-run this arm; if it's only measuring content quality, it stands.
